entities.name: NR1H4 (FXR)
observations: Farnesoid X receptor gene investigated in a cirrhosis/SBP genetic association study.

entities.name: NR1H4 rs56163822
observations: In 293 cirrhotic patients with ascites, GT genotype was reported in 7.0% with SBP versus 1.7% without SBP (OR 4.4, p=0.02); adjusted/logistic model OR 6.8 (p=0.018).

entities.name: Spontaneous bacterial peritonitis
observations: Infection complication studied among patients with cirrhosis and ascites; the rs56163822 GT genotype was associated with increased odds in one cohort.

entities.name: PMID:25086996
observations: Reported association of an FXR/NR1H4 polymorphism with SBP in a prospective cohort of 293 patients with cirrhosis and ascites; 115 had SBP.
